```{=html}
<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@fontsource/maple-mono@5.2.5/index.min.css">
<script src="https://unpkg.com/lucide@latest/dist/umd/lucide.min.js"></script>

<style>
  .wsl-outer {
    width: 100%;
    margin: 1em 0;
    border: 1.5px solid #5654A2;
    border-radius: 14px;
    overflow: hidden;
  }

  .wsl-header {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    background: #5654A2;
    padding: 10px 16px;
  }

  .wsl-header-cell {
    font-family: 'Maple Mono', monospace;
    font-size: 0.85em;
    font-weight: bold;
    color: #F8F7F0;
    letter-spacing: 0.06em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    text-align: center;
  }

  .wsl-row {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: 40% 1fr;
    align-items: stretch;
    border-top: 1px solid #D4D3EE;
    background: #F8F7F0;
  }

  .wsl-card-cell {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    padding: 14px;
    border-right: 1px solid #D4D3EE;
    background: #EEEDF8;
  }

  /* Clickable link-grid-style card: icon chip + label, hover-glow + press. */
  .wsl-card {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: center;
    width: 100%;
    padding: 16px 14px;
    background: #FBFAF6;
    border: 1px solid #E5E4DC;
    border-radius: 10px;
    text-decoration: none;
    cursor: pointer;
    will-change: transform;
    transition: background 0.15s ease, border-color 0.15s ease,
                box-shadow 0.15s ease, transform 0.08s ease;
  }

  .wsl-card:hover {
    background: #F0EFF8;
    border-color: #C4C3E8;
    box-shadow: 0 2px 12px rgba(86, 84, 162, 0.16);
    text-decoration: none;
  }

  .wsl-card:hover .wsl-card-icon { background: #F8F7F0; }

  .wsl-card:active {
    transform: scale(0.98);
    box-shadow: 0 1px 5px rgba(86, 84, 162, 0.14);
  }

  .wsl-card:focus-visible {
    outline: 2px solid #5654A2;
    outline-offset: 2px;
  }

  .wsl-card-icon {
    width: 44px;
    height: 44px;
    border-radius: 10px;
    background: #EEEDF8;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    margin-bottom: 10px;
    flex-shrink: 0;
    transition: background 0.15s ease;
  }

  .wsl-card-icon svg { width: 20px; height: 20px; color: #5654A2; stroke-width: 1.8; }

  .wsl-label {
    font-family: 'Maple Mono', monospace;
    font-size: 0.85em;
    font-weight: bold;
    color: #5654A2;
    line-height: 1.4;
    text-align: center;
  }

  .wsl-desc {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    padding: 14px 20px;
  }

  .wsl-desc > div {
    font-size: 0.95em;
    color: #564232;
    line-height: 1.55;
  }

  .wsl-desc code { white-space: nowrap; }

  @media (max-width: 520px) {
    .wsl-row { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
    .wsl-card-cell { border-right: none; border-bottom: 1px solid #D4D3EE; }
    .wsl-desc { padding: 12px 16px; }
  }
</style>

<div class="wsl-outer">
  <div class="wsl-header">
    <div class="wsl-header-cell">My Workshop Slides as an Example of the Output</div>
  </div>
  <div class="wsl-row">
    <div class="wsl-card-cell">
      <a class="wsl-card" href="https://pingfan-hu.github.io/2026-agentic-workshop/" target="_blank" rel="noopener">
        <div class="wsl-card-icon"><i data-lucide="presentation"></i></div>
        <div class="wsl-label">Visit Site</div>
      </a>
    </div>
    <div class="wsl-desc"><div>My 2026 Summer Workshop on Agentic Workflows with Claude Code. All three slide decks were built with the <code>/ph-slide</code> skill.</div></div>
  </div>
</div>

<script>
  if (typeof lucide !== 'undefined') lucide.createIcons();
</script>
```
